title: Controlling Continuum Robot Shape in Enclosed Space with Embedded Sensing using IMU and Actuator Feedback
summary: Physical closed-loop trials report 6.1%L mean tip error with learned feedback and 2.3%L global error in three-segment control; embedded feedback enables operation without external observation. Physical tests compare MoCap, MLP and LSTM feedback on one- and three-segment robots; hardware-specific measures, including enclosed-space trials, bound the claim. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
